appraisal_events.evidence: "J'avais vu les nobles devenir vulgaires quand leur esprit ... était vulgaire", illustrated by the duke's own remark, "Vous n'êtes pas gêné", which the narrator says Cottard could equally have said.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator singles out the duc de Guermantes as an example of a noble whose mind is vulgar, equating his speech to that of the bourgeois Dr. Cottard, deflating the prestige his rank would otherwise imply.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator's direct claim and quoted vulgar remark locally lower the duke by revealing a common, unrefined mind beneath his aristocratic rank.
